title: Auth — Step-up Approver Revoke — payload
description: Revoke one step-up approver binding — the caller's own, or another subject's within an administrator's authority. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

subject.description: The subject the approver is bound to. Absent means the caller; an administrator revoking on someone's behalf names it.

reason.description: Why the approver is revoked, for the audit record. Free text authored by the caller, untrusted, never published beyond the subject and the administrators over them.

Response.title: Auth — Step-up Approver Revoke — response payload
Response.description: The revoked binding, when it was revoked, and how many approvers the subject still holds.

revokedAt.description: When the binding was revoked — the original time when the approver was already revoked.

remainingApprovers.description: The subject's live approvers after the revocation. Zero is legitimate and recoverable.
